description: This file defines the PdfLinkAnnotation class, which represents a link annotation in a PDF document, supporting creation of different types of links such as document internal links, external web links, file links, and embedded document links.

classes.name: PdfLinkAnnotation
classes.description: Represents a hyperlink annotation in a PDF, supporting various link types such as internal document links, external web links, and embedded documents.

methods.name: CreateDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates an internal document link annotation to a specific page and point within the same document.

methods.name: CreateDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates a document link annotation to a named destination within the same or another document.

methods.name: CreateDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates a document link annotation to an external document and named destination.

methods.name: CreateEmbeddedDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates a link to an embedded document within the current PDF.

methods.name: CreateEmbeddedDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates a link to an embedded document distinguished by document and destination paths.

methods.name: CreateWebLink
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink annotation pointing to a web URL.

methods.name: CreateFileLink
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink annotation pointing to an external file.
